name: Sub Scribe
description: Sub Scribe brings subtitles to Jellyfin from SubDL.com and tvsubtitles.net: it downloads what is missing and uploads your own. Each source has its own switches, nothing goes back to the other source, the order is yours. A TMDb API Key is required, SubDL is optional. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL and tvsubtitles.net — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog: v12.3.5.0: season packs are built by a full, refetch or manual run only — and every source is treated alike. The F-M424 branch, which let an arrival run pack the episodes it happened to bring, is gone: the run at 09:58 on 21.11. built two SubDL packs (MobLand S02, 524.500 B regular and 574.748 B HI) while tvsubtitles.net stood outside the very same run with "stays with a full run". An arrival run now takes no pack scope at all, says so in one line and uploads single; the slot asks only the source switch, so it names subdl and tvsubtitles symmetrically, and the second copy of that question is gone. The arrival-only helpers fell with it (the second season question, the arrival-scoped plan cut). Found on the way and fixed: the id builders are idempotent — upgrading a schema-23 store wrapped the already readable ids a second time (`[FrEI]` became `[[FrEI]]`), the `pack_track` foreign key dropped the transaction and the store stayed halfway while the marker already said 24 (F-M680).
